notes.title: Update 0.9
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed calculation of Space Gambler event options' conditions, now you can only gamble the money you actually have!
- Fixed achievement "You sure you gonna win that back?", now it assigns the achievement correctly
- Hopefully fixed an issue causing units to sometimes stop interacting under really specific conditions
Features
- Added achievement "Cheater!" for using hacking device to cheat the Space Gambler

notes.title: Small update 0.8
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
Fixed friendly error caused by corrupted my generation

Fixed loot dropping from queen, now she drops Alien Heart like she should have

Fixed inventory UI panel that was really hard to drag around the screen

notes.title: Update 0.7
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
Fixed game pooping itself when you kill your own soldier

Fixed friendly error appearing when killed creature hits another with the bullet it shot while it was alive
Features
Added warning while trying to leave while the federation is on a station and you have not yet dealt with them
Balancing
Removed the terminal from the elevator room (it was causing soft locks).

Added elevator to spawn in medbays and offices.

Reduced hacking time from 10 seconds (wtf?) to 3.

Terminals are now destructible and dismantlable  

Reduced the time needed to loot small and big power cells

Reduced amount of enemies needed to be killed to complete the victory condition "Kill Federation Soldiers" from 100% of initially spawned to 75% of initially spawned
Misc
Added creature count per team to the debug panel accessible by pressing F6

notes.title: Small update 0.6
notes.content:
- ensuring correct path for localization on non-windows machines
- decreased enemy spawn rate

notes.title: Update 0.5
notes.content:
Fixes
Audio of Mr. Bonson's attacks has now properly adjusted volume according to audio settings

Patched some friendly errors

Fixed HOLK achievement not registering

Fixed HOLK serum having wrong ID causing the localization to not display the name and the description properly

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.content:
Features
Added error console that will open the log location for you, as well as instructions what to do when you encounter one!

I would want to in the end have some type of server, so you can send the log file with a simple button press. But I'm a little scared of hardcoding an address to a server running on my RassberyPI, so I will have to look into some type of secure way of receiving them, maybe discord hooks?

Changed reload progress bar to yellow to indicate the interaction is reloading, and nothing else

Hopefully fixed the localization not loading for Linux

Made the ammo UI fade away instead of suddenly disappearing
Fixes
Infinite reloading glitch caused by upgraded ammo capacity

Fixed player crew to get suck on props when ordering them to go to unreachable places

Fixed creature pathing through 2 diagonal props

notes.title: Update 0.3
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed "Apply Upgrade" button being interactable when you already have crew (ship) upgrade of this type.
- Fixed units not reloading when idling
- Fixed medkits having interaction that DOES NOTHING

Balancing
- Disabled zombie boomers spawning in the first sector
- Added a weapon trade station in the initial location
- Decreased amount of enemies spawning

Features
- Changes in main menu
- Added links to socials
- Added current ammo display
- Added edge panning for camera
- Added small shadow to the font so its more readable

Misc
- Added new cheat commands

notes.title: Update 0.2 (ONLY LINUX)
notes.content:
Few new features still in development only released on the Linux version.
Mostly for debugging purposes

notes.title: Update 0.1
notes.content:
- Added setting for disabling pixelart font
- Added missing polish language localization
- Small tweaks to the tutorial level
- Balance tweaks

notes.title: Post Launch Patch 2
notes.content:
Features:
- updated default sound settings (default sound volume decreased especially for UI elements)
- now difficulty affects enemies health, but more of them spawn on lower difficulties
- updated accuracy logic

Bug Fixes:
- fixed reload time upgrade calculations
- fix in game inventory scroll sensitivity
- stopped larva spawner weapon from bricking the game 
- fix achievement for killing an end boss

notes.title: The Hive Update
notes.content:
Added new enemy spawning in The Hive - Cerebrate

Added new item Larva Spawner which drops from the Cerebrate. Each attack spawns a friendly larva fighting on your side

Added custom props for the hive location

Added new achievements and triggers for them

Misc balance changes, major one is increase damage of larva

Map generation changes

Bug Fixes, including a notorious bug that was causing the map shadows to go nuts

Fixed Madam Eva sprite

Added new options for spatial audio

Made audio local to not hear the entire map

UI fixes

Updated the engine

Added reforging in the upgrader menu

notes.title: Update: New boss location, new federation enemy, new faction, world gen
notes.content:
Changed world generation, 

regions will have from 1 to 3 shops,

the amount of event locations is now random as well, but on average reduced

first region now will always have less locations

first region instead of being Zombie themed, now is "mixed", with aliens and zombies

Now there are 6 regions per game

Starting Location

Aliens - Bloodspawn / Zombies - Megatron

Aliens - Queen / Zombies - Killerbot

Aliens - Queen / Zombies - HULK Laboratory

Federation Zone

F.M.S Zone

Added new boss location

Bandit Hideout is a new boss location in the starting region

It does not contain a boss per se, but one of the rooms is a "Bandit Stash" which contains multiple big boxes, weapon cabinet as well as a new special bandit box, which will contain upgrader module.

Bandit Hideout is filled with two new units

Bandit Melee

Bandit Gunner

Added French localization

Intro now is disabled

Added new localization keys

New federation enemy: "Marauder", special enemy attacking using a mini-grenade launcher

New Item: mini-grenade launcher, only obtainable by killing Marauders

Now Marauders spawn in the 4th region

Marauders have been added to the F.M.S.

notes.title: Update: balance changes, ship upgrades
notes.content:
- balance changes, nerf to all regeneration items

- reduced health for the alien queen

- increased attack speed of alien queen by 12%

- you can only access upgrader in shop nodes

- added new trader specializing in ship upgrades

- added ship upgrades, 

   upgrader - allows accessing upgrader outside of shops

   enemy counter - shows count of enemies on the map

   fuel pumps - gives 33% chance to not use fuel on travel

   juice pumps - decrease juice usage by 25%.

   advanced flashlights - increase crew vision by 25%

- ship upgrades can provide additional options for events

- enemy manage gathering changes -> decreased mana growth, increased base mana income

- federation soldier buff -> +33% damage, 1 more HP, decreased speed by 14%

- from regions 3+ federation stations will also spawn Special OPS

- increased XP of Special OPS

- decreased attack speed of rifle by 25%, decreased damage of rifle by 20%

- increased cost of a flamethrower

- decreased pushback of shotgun

- decreased pushback of sniper rifle

- general nerf to energy sword

- decreased armor efficiency

- general nerf to "defense" of melee weapons
